Class Event

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.events.Event
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    EventI, java.io.Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    BatteryLevel, Compressing, CurrentValue, ES_Event, LowBattery, NotCompressing, TicEvent, TicEvent, WiFiBandwidthReading

    public class Event
extends java.lang.Object
implements EventI
    The abstract class Event provides the default base implementation for simulation events.

      • Event

        public Event(Time timeOfOccurrence,
             EventInformationI content)
        create an event from the given time of occurrence and event description.

        Contract

         pre     timeOfOccurrence != null
 post    getTimeOfOccurrence().equals(timeOfOccurrence)
 post    content == null || getEventInformation().equals(content)
        Parameters:
        timeOfOccurrence - time of occurrence of the created event.
        content - description of the created event.
